content:
maria: quick heads up — after today's private deploy we see higher p50 for small-vpc slices when prefill is enabled. reproducing on t4-small clusters.

sanjay: saw that. can you paste the profiler snapshot?

maria: grabbing now. main symptoms: longer batch formation, lots of 50–80ms gaps waiting on memcpy + kernel select fallback.

maria: profiler snippet:
```
BatchFormation: 38ms
KVLookup: 4ms
MemcpyHostToDevice: 62ms (spike)
KernelSelectFallback: 1.5x latency penalty
KernelExec: 15ms
```

taylor: memcpy spikes usually mean we're not batching contiguous requests — are we letting small batches get pushed early? what's the `token_budget_target` on these VPC configs?

maria: default `token_budget_target` = 1024 in private config. For small-gpu slices allocated to customers we saw 512 was the historical value.

devon: aha — when token budget >> model average tokens, the batcher waits to fill, but the small GPUs get starved so prefill kicks and ends up doing many host->device copies. On tiny GPU, memcpy dominates.

lina: suggestion: add a per-vpc override `max_batch_wait_ms` and lower `token_budget_target` for constrained slices. maybe `max_batch_wait_ms=10` and `token_budget_target=512`?

maria: tried local patch with `max_batch_wait_ms=12` and `token_budget_target=480`. p50 came down ~18%, p95 steady.

sanjay: nice. did kernel selection still fall back?

maria: fewer fallbacks. turning down target reduced sequence variance so compiler picks the fast fused-kernel more often.

devon: we should also tweak queue policy. VPCs with small slices should prefer `age_priority` so older requests don't get preempted by large incoming ones. Default is `size_priority`.

taylor: agree. `age_priority` reduces starvation but might slightly increase average latency for bursty tenants. acceptable tradeoff for predictability.

lina: can we add a config map for Private: {"token_budget_target": "per-slice", "max_batch_wait_ms": "per-slice", "queue_policy": "per-slice"} and a validation rule that `token_budget_target<=slice_capacity_tokens`?

maria: I'll prototype the override API today. plan: 1) add per-slice override, 2) wire into batcher, 3) run 24h soak against t4-small fleet.

ops-bot: deploy triggered by maria - staging rollout pinned to slice-group small-vpc-test at 2025-07-18T15:04:00Z

devon: also flag: KV cache eviction is more aggressive on small VPCs due to memory constraints. that interacts with prefill because cache misses cause extra KV lookups and memcpy. need to ensure eviction_threshold isn't too low.

maria: good call — current eviction_threshold=0.65 for small slices; increased to 0.8 in the patch and saw reduced KV miss rate from 12% -> 4%.

sanjay: action items:
- maria: submit PR for per-slice overrides + default presets for small-vpc (token_budget=480, max_batch_wait_ms=12, queue_policy=age_priority, eviction_threshold=0.8)
- devon: add unit test for memcpy spike detection in batcher metrics
- taylor: run kernel-select profiling before/after on staging and capture kernel fallback counts

lina: add docs link to runbook when deploying these presets: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/batching-vpc-small (draft)

maria: will open PR and ping reviewers. watching staging metrics now, will update thread with soak results. :eyes:

taylor: thanks — if soak looks good we can roll to canary for affected customers tomorrow. :+1:

maria: update 2054321890 — 6h soak: p50 -20%, p95 -10%, kernel-fallbacks down 65%, KV miss down to 3.8%. promoting to canary next.

devon: great numbers. please include perf counters export so we can compare memory copy percent over time.

maria: will attach stats in the PR.
